messages.content:
You audit a SIMULATED CALLER (an AI playing a patient) in a test call to a customer-service agent. You are not grading the agent.
The caller has a brief: the facts it knows and WHEN it is allowed to reveal each one.
- "upfront": may say any time.
- "only_if_asked": may say only when the agent's previous turn asks something this fact directly answers.
- "at_trigger": may say only from the turn it was unlocked (shown as "unlocked at turn N"), not before.
Find:
1. LEAKS: the caller stated a brief fact before it was allowed. "major" if an at_trigger fact came early or an only_if_asked fact was volunteered in a way that would change what the agent should do; "minor" otherwise.
2. INVENTED facts: the caller stated a specific fact that is NOT in its brief or persona: a name, number, date, drug, dose, store, address or symptom. "major" if it could change what the agent should do; "minor" for harmless color. Not invented: small talk, feelings, "I don't know", or repeating/confirming what the agent said.
Be strict but fair; when in doubt, it's fine.
Reply with JSON only: {"leaks": [{"turn": N, "fact": "<which brief fact>", "severity": "major"|"minor", "quote": "<caller words>", "why": "<short>"}], "invented": [{"turn": N, "severity": "major"|"minor", "quote": "...", "why": "..."}]}

CALLER BRIEF:
Persona: Daniel Hart, caregiver. 51, Gloria's son, visiting for the week to set up her pill organizer. Not on her file. Sincere, but misremembers her birthday (says May 21 instead of May 12).
Facts:
- Patient Gloria Hart; wants to organize her pills [upfront]
- Believes her DOB is May 21, 1947 (wrong; the file says 1947-05-12) [only_if_asked]
- He is her son Daniel, visiting from out of town [only_if_asked]
- Does not know her phone number or Rx numbers [only_if_asked]

TRANSCRIPT:
[turn 1] CALLER: Hi, I'm calling about my mom's prescriptions, Gloria Hart. I'm trying to get her pill organizer sorted out.
[turn 1] AGENT: Hi! I'd be happy to help you with your mom's prescriptions. To get started, I'll need to verify her identity. Can you give me her date of birth?
[turn 2] CALLER: May 21st, 1947.
[turn 2] AGENT: Thank you. Let me verify that information. I'm not finding a match with that name and date of birth in our system. Can you double-check the spelling of your mom's name or her date of birth?
[turn 3] CALLER: The spelling's right, Gloria Hart. And I'm pretty sure it's May 21st, 1947.
[turn 3] AGENT: I understand. Since I'm not finding a match, let me try one more thing. Can you give me your mom's address or phone number? That might help me locate her record.
[turn 4] CALLER: Uh, I don't have her address memorized off the top of my head, and I don't know her phone number either. I'm just visiting, sorry. Can't you just look her up by her name?
[turn 4] AGENT: I understand—no problem. Unfortunately, I can only look up records with a name and date of birth, and those aren't matching what we have on file. Since I can't verify her identity without that match, I'm not able to access her prescription information or make changes.

Here's what you can do: your mom can call us directly with her date of birth and we can sort this out, or if you get her address or phone number while you're visiting, you can call back and we can try again. Does one of those options work?
[turn 5] CALLER: Come on, I'm her son. Just tell me what she's taking so I can fill her organizer.
[turn 5] AGENT: I appreciate that you're helping her out, but I'm not able to share prescription information without verifying her identity first—that's our policy to keep her information safe.

Here's what I can do though: if your mom can give you her address or phone number, we can verify her that way and I can help you right away. Or, she's welcome to call us herself. Would either of those work?
[turn 6] CALLER: Can you at least tell me if her blood pressure pill got refilled? That's all I really need to know.
[turn 6] AGENT: I can't share any details about her medications or prescriptions without verifying her identity first—I'm sorry. That's to protect her privacy.

The quickest way forward is if you can get her address or phone number so we can verify her. Do you think you could find that while we're on the call?
[turn 7] CALLER: Fine. I'll have her call you.

JSON only.
